IF( AND(ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId),OR(RecordType.DeveloperName ='IME_Standard_Opportunity',RecordType.DeveloperName ='IMAP_Standard_Opportunity',RecordType.DeveloperName ='IMLA_Standard_Opportunity',RecordType.DeveloperName ='Standard_Opportunity')), If(OR( ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Data Centers"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Digital Solutions"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "DM Cloud Solutions"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "DM SITAD"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "DM Tape Vaulting"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "DM (All other service lines)"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Entertainment Services"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Information Governance"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Insight"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "RM Secure Storage"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "RM (All other service lines)"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Secure Shredding"), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "SMB Packages") /* ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Other") */ ),false,true),false), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
